terms.label: All
terms.definition: Root of the HPO hierarchy.

terms.label: Phenotypic abnormality
terms.definition: A phenotypic abnormality that can be observed clinically.

terms.label: Abnormality of the cardiovascular system
terms.definition: Any abnormality of the heart or blood vessels.

terms.label: Myocardial infarction
terms.definition: Necrosis of the myocardium due to interrupted blood supply.

terms.label: Abnormality of the coronary arteries
terms.definition: Any structural or functional abnormality of the coronary arteries.

terms.label: Congenital heart defect
terms.definition: A structural abnormality of the heart present at birth.

terms.label: Abnormality of lung morphology
terms.definition: Any structural abnormality of the lungs.

terms.label: Asthma
terms.definition: Asthma, a chronic inflammatory disorder of the airways.

terms.label: Pneumonia
terms.definition: Inflammation of the lung parenchyma.

terms.label: Functional respiratory abnormality
terms.definition: Any abnormality of respiratory function.

terms.label: Dyspnea
terms.definition: Difficult or labored breathing.

terms.label: Abnormal eye morphology
terms.definition: Any structural abnormality of the eye.

terms.label: Visual impairment
terms.definition: Reduced ability to see to a degree that causes problems not fixable by usual means.

terms.label: Retinopathy
terms.definition: Any non-inflammatory disease of the retina.

terms.label: Diabetes mellitus
terms.definition: A group of metabolic disorders characterized by hyperglycemia over a prolonged period.

terms.label: Type I diabetes mellitus
terms.definition: Autoimmune destruction of pancreatic beta cells leading to insulin deficiency.

terms.label: Type II diabetes mellitus
terms.definition: Insulin resistance with relative insulin deficiency.

terms.label: Obesity
terms.definition: Excessive body fat accumulation with adverse health effects.

terms.label: Increased body weight
terms.definition: Body weight above the normal range for age and sex.

terms.label: Hyperlipidemia
terms.definition: Elevated levels of lipids in the blood.
